items.title: Ship the single-player property game
items.notes: The browser game covers token selection, property decisions, end-of-game results, and restart.

items.title: Run the game on the Next.js App Router with TypeScript
items.notes: The application includes pnpm commands for development, type checking, production build, and start.

items.title: Preserve the original Weird Web October URLs
items.notes: The root page and statistics handlers have legacy rewrites under /2025/spooky.

items.title: Persist token unlocks in the browser
items.notes: A finished game can unlock new tokens for future runs in the same browser origin without Supabase.

items.title: Connect shared statistics to Supabase
items.notes: The app can submit and aggregate results through the existing wwo_2025_spooky_game_stats table when configured. A live environment is a separate verification item.

items.title: Document the project and contributor workflow
items.notes: The README links to the guides, agent instructions, and structured roadmap. The first inventory uses its creation date for earlier work without a recorded completion timestamp.
